svg.title: Project: StudySensei (Phase 2 of 9). Turns your own course material into a topic map you control, finds the exact page for any question, and times study sessions that survive reloads and lost connections. React , FastAPI , Postgres + pgvector. 208 commits.

g.text: Turns your own course material into a topic map you control,
finds the exact page for any question, and times study
sessions that survive reloads and lost connections.
